mixed_sell_phased.notes: Parks proceeds in 3M–2Y Treasuries (CA tax-exempt) & phases into equities; shows reinvestment drag

scenarios.name: 1929 Great Depression Entry
scenarios.description: Severe deflationary equity crash (-45%, -30%, -15% in yrs 1–3) followed by slow recovery; Bay Area real estate drops -25% over 3 yrs.
scenarios.reinvestment_risk_note: Treasury yields fall from 3.5% to 1.0% during deflation; however, avoiding the -67% cumulative equity drawdown dominates.

scenarios.name: 1970s Stagflation & High Inflation
scenarios.description: High inflation (8–11%), stagnant real equities (-15%, -10%, +5%), high nominal Treasury yields (7–9%), strong nominal real estate (+9%/yr).
scenarios.reinvestment_risk_note: High nominal Treasury yields soften equity stagflation, but real purchasing power erodes if inflation exceeds after-tax Treasury yield.

scenarios.name: 2000 Dot-Com / Silicon Valley Shock
scenarios.description: 3-year tech equity bear market (-12%, -18%, -22%); Cupertino rent dips -15% while home values stall before recovering.
scenarios.reinvestment_risk_note: Fed cuts short-term rates sharply (reinvestment risk on maturing 3M–2Y Treasuries), yet phased entry buys equities near 2002–2003 lows.

scenarios.name: 2008 Global Financial Crisis
scenarios.description: Sharp -38% equity crash in Yr 1, +25% rebound in Yr 2; Bay Area real estate -18% peak-to-trough; Treasury yields drop near 0.2%.
scenarios.reinvestment_risk_note: Severe reinvestment risk: 3M–2Y Treasuries roll over near 0.2% after Yr 1, and phasing misses part of the Yr 2 +25% V-shaped rebound.

scenarios.name: 2022 Inflation & Rate-Spike Shock
scenarios.description: Stocks -18% and long bonds -15% simultaneously in Yr 1, followed by +22% equity rebound in Yr 2; 3M–2Y Treasuries jump to 4.5–5.0%.
scenarios.reinvestment_risk_note: Short-duration 3M–2Y Treasuries avoid long-bond duration loss, but phasing still trails lump-sum if Yr 2–3 equities surge +44%.
